onb.title: Welcome to NewsCrawler Buddy!
onb.sub: Collect news into clean datasets for your machine-learning projects.
onb.agree: I will follow the site's robots.txt and terms of use
legal.title: Responsible crawling
legal.text: Data is for personal or research use. You are responsible for copyright and terms-of-use compliance. This app does not bypass paywalls, logins or CAPTCHAs, and it blocks sites that disallow crawling in robots.txt.
tips: A longer delay means you're less likely to get blocked.|Try Demo mode first: no real website is contacted.|RSS feeds are the politest way to collect full articles.|Keep 80/10/10 with stratify so every category appears in each split.|You can pause and resume a job without losing data.

robots.reason.partial: Some parts of the site are disallowed.
robots.reason.crawl_delay: The site asks for a crawl delay.
robots.reason.restricted: robots.txt could not be read (access denied), so crawling is blocked.

method.domain.title: Domain crawl
method.domain.when: Use when you need the full article text from a news site.
method.domain.pros: Full article text|No API key needed|Large volume possible
method.domain.cons: Slower because of polite delays|Depends on site layout|Must respect robots.txt
method.api.title: News API
method.api.when: Use when you have an API key and want clean, structured results.
method.api.pros: Structured data|Fast and stable|Filters by keyword, country and date
method.api.cons: API key needed|Daily quota limits|Free tiers often return only snippets
method.demo.title: Demo mode
method.demo.when: Try the whole app with a built-in fake news site. No real website is contacted.
method.demo.cons: Fake sample data only|Not for real training
quiz.title: Help me choose
quiz.q1: Do you need the full article text?
quiz.q2: Do you have an API key?
quiz.q3: Do you need a large volume?
method.index.title: Index crawl
method.index.when: Use when a site has an index or archive page that lists many articles over several pages.
method.index.pros: Collects every link from paged archives|Auto-detects pagination and the link pattern|Everything can be adjusted by hand
method.index.cons: Needs a correct link pattern (regex)|Many index pages means more requests
idx.intro: Give an index page (for example a daily archive). We find the other index pages, keep the article links that match a pattern, then extract every article.
idx.url.hint: The first page of the index or archive list.
idx.scanned: Analyzed: {n} links found on the page.
idx.pages.title: Step 1 - Index pages
idx.pages.hint: Auto-detected from the page. Edit anything that looks wrong. All listed pages are read; the crawler only stops early when a page is missing (404), or after the number of empty pages you set below.
idx.stop_empty: Stop after N empty pages in a row
idx.stop_empty.hint: 0 = never stop early (recommended). Index pages often contain no matching links for several pages in a row.
log.index_empty_stop: Stopped: {n} index pages in a row had no matching links (page {page})
log.index_enough: Enough candidates ({n}) after {pages} index page(s); not reading more index pages
idx.template.hint: Use {n} for the page number, e.g. https://site.com/list?page={n} or https://site.com/list/{n}/
idx.end: Last page number (or max pages when following Next)
idx.first: Also read the index URL itself (as the first page)
idx.follow: Follow the 'Next' link instead of using a template
idx.det.query: Detected: page number in the query string
idx.det.path: Detected: page number in the path
idx.pages.follow: Up to {n} page(s) will be read by following 'Next'.
idx.pattern.title: Step 2 - Article link pattern
idx.pattern.hint: A regular expression (Python syntax) that article URLs must match. Pick a suggestion or write your own.
idx.test.need: Analyze the page first to test the pattern.
idx.test.result: {n} of {total} links on the first page match.
idx.test.zero: No links match. Try another suggestion.
log.index_end: Reached the end of the index at page {page}
msg.bad_pattern: The link pattern is not a valid regular expression.
msg.pattern_required: Please enter or pick a link pattern.
msg.bad_template: The page template must contain {n} and stay on the same site.
msg.bad_range: The last page must not be smaller than the first page.
